newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BOURSE HALTS TRADE IN SUN INTNL PENDING NEWS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE HALTS TRADE IN SUN INTNL PENDING NEWS.

text.p: The Brussels bourse said on Thursday it had decided to halt trade in shares in Sun International for the day in anticipation of the publication of a statement.
Sun is listed on the double fixing, cash market.
At Sun International no one was available for comment. The company was due to hold a news conference at 11:30 local (0930 GMT). Information on the subject of the meeting was not available.
On Wednesday the share closed at 2,640 francs. Its year high was 2,800, posted on March 11, while the low of 2,260 francs was set on January 22.
